# uzc_ip_address (Resource)

Acquires a UzCloud IP address, attached to either a VPC or a network. There is no update endpoint for IP addresses in the spec, so changing any attribute recreates the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Exactly one of `vpc` or `network` must be set.
resource "uzc_ip_address" "example" {
  network       = uzc_network.example.slug
  plan          = "ip-1"
  billing_cycle = "monthly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plan` (String) Plan slug governing the IP allocation.

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset.
- `network` (String) Network slug to attach the IP to. Mutually exclusive with `vpc`.
- `vm_guest_id` (String) Unique ID of the virtual machine guest this IP is allocated for, if any.
- `vpc` (String) VPC slug to attach the IP to. Mutually exclusive with `network`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `ipaddress` (String)
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import.
- `strategy` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `virtual_machine_id` (String)
- `virtual_machine_name` (String)
